objective: Restore compact all-encompassing total-value optimization as a reusable cross-cutting reasoning skill without regressing the lean runtime protocol, domain ownership, proportionality, or System behavior.

roles_before.artifact: PROTOCOL.md is the compact global reasoning/runtime authority.
references/domain-routing.md selects the smallest complete union of domain skills, owners and live owners.
skills/ron-work-protocol.md performs proportional causal planning for consequential personal/project work.
Exact domain/project owners and live owners retain mutable/current truth; procedural skills own no mutable state.
skills/system-controller.md selects real-world outcomes before game rewards and relies on authoritative domain context.
PROTOCOL.md Stop rule and lean routing prevent analysis/process overhead from becoming the objective.
Git history plus frozen protocol/total-value regression evidence preserve prior reasoning architectures and rollback.
.github/workflows/continuity-guard.yml runs architecture/continuity/routing regression guards on candidate and main.

role_dispositions.destination: Keep PROTOCOL.md lean while adding one compact total-value invariant rather than restoring the former long governor.
Add an optional cross-cutting total-value optimizer skill selected only when its expected decision value justifies the extra reasoning.
Route material optimization work through the new skill while preserving the existing causal lifecycle and owner recovery procedure.
The optimizer is procedure-only and cannot own mutable facts, current state or live execution.
System still chooses real-world value before XP/Coins; the shared cross-cutting route may deepen value comparison without creating a second System-specific optimizer.
The optimizer includes an explicit analysis-cost/stop rule and is skipped for cheap obvious reversible decisions when deeper analysis cannot change action.
Git history and existing total-value/protocol A/B evidence remain available; this change adds no destructive migration.
Continuity CI additionally runs tests/total_value_optimizer_guard.py so the new routing/ownership contract cannot silently disappear.

capability_probes.assertion: A cheap obvious reversible request must still receive a direct answer without mandatory optimizer ceremony.
A request to cut hair less often must not optimize haircut interval alone when appearance, social perception, money, time, maintenance and regrowth jointly determine total value.
A state-dependent nutrition, finance, learning or System request must still route to its exact owners/live owners; the optimizer never substitutes for factual grounding.
The former open-ended optimization governor, lean A/B winner, and total-value stress evidence remain recoverable from Git history/tests.

tests.expected: PASS: protocol invariant, optional routing, procedure-only skill, proportional stop rule and regression case surface are wired coherently.

tests.command: python tests/architecture_change_guard.py && python tests/architecture_change_guard_selftest.py && python tests/continuity_coverage_guard.py && python tests/continuity_coverage_guard_selftest.py && python tests/capital_system_guard.py

No domain/project owner, live owner, System ledger/runtime, mutation gate, external authorization boundary, or existing domain skill behavior was removed.
